item.title: Venezuela and the Caribbean: the situation
item.description:
President Maduro remains detained in Venezuela while studying religion behind bars, and his wife continues to seek his release. U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth faces impeachment resolutions from Rep. Thomas Massie and other Republicans over alleged war actions linked to Iran and a raid tied to Maduro, while former President Trump publicly defends him. The conflict environment stays active, with the UCDP reporting 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.
